t: The $(9)Fortron Capacitor$() serves as an energy storage and management device for MFFS machines. It's designed to collect Fortron generated by $(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Coercion Deriver$()s and transfer it to other machines that need $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() to operate, essentially acting as a "hub".
$(9)Fortron 能量储存器$()是MFFS机器的能量存储与管理设备。其设计初衷是收集由$(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Fortron 衍生器$()生成的Fortron，并将其输送至需要$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$()才能运行的其他机器，本质上充当一个“中心枢纽”。

Place the Capacitor and set which frequency it should use. By default, Capacitors use frequency number 0, but this can be changed either by:$(li)Right-clicking the Capacitor and entering the desired frequency number into its GUI$(li)Shift-right-clicking the Capacitor while holding a $(l:mffs:tools/frequency_card)Frequency Card$().
放置电容器并设定其使用的频率。默认情况下，电容器使用频率编号0，但可通过以下任一方式更改：$(li)右键点击电容器并在其GUI界面中输入目标频率编号$(li)手持$(l:mffs:tools/frequency_card)频率卡$()对电容器按住Shift键右击。

Activate the Fortron Capacitor by supplying it with a Redstone signal. Once activated, the Capacitor will change from red to blue and begin transferring $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() between other MFFS devices that use the same frequency and are within range (default 15 blocks).
通过提供红石信号来激活Fortron 能量储存器。一旦激活，电容器将由红色变为蓝色，并开始在相同频率且距离范围内（默认15格）的其他MFFS设备之间传输$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$()。

A Fortron Capacitor may be augmented with various modules to enhance its capabilities:$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)Scale Module$(): Enables the Capacitor to link with other MFFS machines over a larger distance. Each module increases the range by 1 block from the default of 15 blocks.$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)Speed Module$(): Allows the Capacitor to transfer $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() to and from machines more quickly. Each module increases the transfer rate by 50 FE.

Fortron 能量储存器可通过安装多种模块来增强其能力：$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/scale_module)$(5)扩展模块$()：使电容器能与更远距离的其他MFFS机器建立连接。每安装一个模块，其作用范围将在默认15格基础上增加1格。$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)速度模块$()：加快电容器向机器传输$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$()的速度。每安装一个模块，传输速率将提升50 FE。
$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/capacity_module)$(5)Capacity Module$(): Increases the amount of $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() the Capacitor is able to store.
$(li)$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/capacity_module)$(5)容量模块$()：提升电容器可储存的$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$()总量。
